about.title: About Fregia Health Insurance Services
text: We are based in Liberty and available for in-person visits to assist with your insurance needs.
Our team is available throughout the year to answer questions and provide ongoing support.

At Fregia Health Insurance Services, we are dedicated to helping individuals and families make confident decisions about their health coverage. With over 13 years of experience, we focus on Medicare plans, including Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, and Part D prescription drug coverage. As an independent agency, we represent many insurance companies, allowing us to compare options and provide recommendations to address your needs and budget.
